purpose: Teach: この世/イチゴ/味覚/いちご/訪ねる/アイロン/新生児/取り替え

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、本気で、絶対、この世、絶対、で、絶対、一番、絶対、頑張ろうね
lines.en: Riku — I'm serious, we're going to try harder than anyone else in this world, okay?
lines.style: Bright and earnest, slightly breathless with conviction. Leans forward. The energy of someone making a promise she means to keep. A little vulnerable underneath the intensity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。学校で、本気で、絶対、イチゴ、絶対、デザート、絶対、出たぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. At school today — they actually had strawberry for dessert, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick, pleased. A small smile in the voice. Sharing something small because it matters to her that he noticed. Genuine without trying to perform genuineness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、給食の、絶対、味覚、絶対、敏感だよね、リク
lines.en: You're seriously sensitive to taste, aren't you? I mean from lunch.
lines.style: Observant, slight wonder underneath. Not quite a question — more like noticing something true about him. Soft and steady. A little fondness settling in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、いちご、絶対、畑、絶対、あるぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah, my grandmother's place actually has a strawberry field. I've got good taste because of that.
lines.style: Quiet pride. A small, genuine laugh underneath. Sharing something personal without making it dramatic. Pace is unhurried, like he's inviting her into a small memory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんちを、本気で、絶対、訪ねる、絶対、と、絶対、いつも、絶対、楽しいよね、リク
lines.en: Visiting your grandfather's place with you is always fun, you know?
lines.style: Warm and direct. No performance. Saying something honest in a way that feels safe. Slight smile held in the voice. Eye-level with him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、本気で、絶対、アイロン、絶対、使い方、絶対、習ったよな、桜
lines.en: We learned how to use an iron in home ec, remember?
lines.style: Casual, remembering out loud. A small shift — moving between moments they've shared. Not quite a question. The tone of someone comfortable sitting in memories together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お姉ちゃん、本気で、絶対、新生児、絶対、抱っこ、絶対、上手だよ、リク
lines.en: My older sister is really good at holding newborns.
lines.style: Soft observation. Tender without being sentimental. The voice of someone noticing something gentle and letting it rest there. Slight pause before speaking, like the image is vivid to her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部室の、本気で、絶対、机の、絶対、取り替え、絶対、俺たち、絶対、お手伝いしたぜ、桜
lines.en: We helped replace the desks in the club room together, didn't we?
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction closing the thought. Gentle pride — not in boasting but in the fact of it: they did something together and it mattered. Pace slows slightly at the end, settling on the memory.
